card.name: Doctor in accidental overdose warning
card.fires_on: The word "doctor" in the stock warning "In case of accidental overdose, call a doctor or poison control center". It also fires weakly on "risks" in opioid addiction warnings and "cautious" in elderly dose-selection text.

modes.label: The phrase about calling a doctor
modes.description: "doctor" right after "call a" in the accidental overdose warning on iron and similar products.
modes.example: In case of accidental overdose, call a<< doctor>> or poison control center immediately.

modes.label: The phrase about exposing users to the risks
modes.description: "risks" after "exposes users/patients to the" in opioid boxed warnings about addiction, abuse and misuse.
modes.example: Hydrocodone Polistirex and Chlorpheniramine Polistirex exposes patients and other users to the<< risks>> of opioid addiction, abuse, and misuse

modes.label: The wording on cautious elderly dosing
modes.description: "cautious" in the geriatric statement that dose selection should be cautious.
